summary: Isaiah calls for the bonds of wickedness to be loosened. Asaph uses the same word for what the prosperous seem to escape even at death.

senses.definition: Something that binds or constrains. Isaiah sets loosening these bonds beside untying the straps of a yoke and setting the oppressed free. Psalm 73 applies the image to the suffering the wicked appear to escape.

note: The two occurrences are plural. The noun supplies its consonants where the database has no root. The precise force of the death phrase in Psalm 73 is uncertain.
